tasks.short: Submit a complete loan application to a credit analyst for verification.

steps.what: Check the application, evidence list and consent status before handover

loop.input: application fields, consent record and required-evidence checklist
loop.output: completed handover checklist with source links and missing items
loop.check: the officer checks the document versions, consent and required items before submission
loop.stop: stop when consent, a required attachment or a current document is absent; return the case to the owner
loop.why_not_simpler: The case has a fixed checklist but its documents and exception notes arrive in varied forms.

steps.what: Create the analyst work item with the evidence links, requested review and due date
Explain an unusual case or answer the analyst's clarification request
Track the analyst recommendation and notify the next case owner

tasks.design: A {WORKFLOW} handover checks required fields and consent, then creates a versioned analyst work item from the {CRM} rather than an email bundle. The loan officer still resolves unusual facts with the analyst and the status returns to the case automatically.
tasks.previous_blocker: The analyst receives an email packet whose attachments, status and missing items must be checked again.
tasks.enabler_now: A case checklist and routing rule can create a traceable internal handover.
tasks.still_hard: An analyst needs context for an unusual borrower or inconsistent evidence.
tasks.human_edge: The officer can explain why a fact is unusual and obtain the missing context quickly.

ambition.what: Give analysts a queue of complete applications with a stated review question and due date.

tasks.altitude: The officer manages evidence quality and recurring handover failures rather than copying files into referrals.

reach.task: Specify the evidence and exceptions needed for a recommendation
reach.learn: Write a review question that distinguishes missing evidence from risk judgement.

evidence.claim: The digest describes integrations for gathering financial data and workflow routing for exceptions.

assumptions: The boundary starts with an application ready for analyst review and ends when its review status is returned to the case.
The handover contract contains case ID, analyst question, evidence links, document versions, consent state, priority, due date and owner; the loan officer supplies the review question.
A missing consent or attachment blocks submission and is repaired by the officer.
Native case routing and task features are tested before custom workflow code.
One hour per 100 focal-role baseline hours is allowed for changing analyst checklists and monitoring failed handovers.
unknowns: Which attachments analysts require by loan type.
Whether analysts can work from source links instead of copied files.
research_questions: How often are applications returned as incomplete?
Which analyst questions repeat across applications?

already_counted.description: Officer check of the handover package

incremental.description: Maintain handover checklist and repair failed routes

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes many applications need live clarification; one upkeep hour per 100 baseline hours is deducted.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Review loan agreements for completeness and policy accuracy.

steps.what: Receive the executed or draft agreement and identify its case, product and version
Compare names, amount, repayment, rate, fees, dates and signatures with the approved case and policy rules

loop.input: agreement text, approved case terms and policy checklist
loop.output: field comparison with clause references and exceptions
loop.check: the officer checks every exception and the source clause before marking the agreement accurate
loop.stop: stop on a missing signature, changed commercial term, conflicting identity or unrecognised clause; send the agreement for correction
loop.why_not_simpler: Clause positions and wording can vary, although the approved values and required checks are fixed.

steps.what: Record a pass or issue a correction request with the precise clause and mismatch
Resolve a policy exception or ambiguous agreement wording with the appropriate owner

tasks.design: A {WORKFLOW} review takes the agreement version and approved case terms from {DOCS} and the {CRM}, then applies fixed field and signature checks. It produces clause-linked exceptions for a loan officer; a pass or a correction request is recorded without rekeying.
tasks.previous_blocker: The officer reads an agreement beside the case record and manually describes each mismatch.
tasks.enabler_now: Agreement fields and policy checklists can be compared systematically, with a bounded read of variable clause text.
tasks.still_hard: An unusual clause or policy exception needs accountable interpretation before a customer document is changed.
tasks.human_edge: The officer can assess materiality and explain a correction in the context of the approved lending case.

ambition.what: Provide a clause-linked correction request that lets a contract administrator fix an agreement without a second search.

tasks.altitude: The officer improves contract controls by reviewing exception patterns instead of rechecking standard fields.

reach.task: Correct an agreement from a clause-linked review result

evidence.claim: The digest recommends source tie-outs and review before financial documents are relied on.

assumptions: The boundary starts with an agreement version and ends with a pass, correction request or documented exception.

The comparison contract contains agreement ID, version, borrower names, amount, rate, fees, repayment schedule, effective date, signature state, policy version and source-clause link; the contract and case systems supply the fields.
A scanned or unclear clause is reviewed from the original rather than inferred.
Native document fields and workflow rules are tested before a custom comparison.
Two hours per 100 focal-role baseline hours are allowed for clause-map maintenance and exceptional-document review.
unknowns: Whether agreements are born-digital or often scanned.
Which policy rules vary by product or jurisdiction.
research_questions: Which agreement fields generate the most correction requests?
How often does a comparison exception prove to be material?

already_counted.description: Officer review of clause comparison exceptions

incremental.description: Maintain clause mappings and investigate exceptional documents

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes variable wording and exceptions need officer judgement; two upkeep hours per 100 baseline hours are deducted.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Review and update credit and loan files.

steps.what: Receive a changed document, payment event or customer update and identify the affected file
Compare changed facts with the current credit file and identify fields and documents that need updating

loop.input: current credit-file fields and updated customer documents
loop.output: proposed field changes with source links and conflicts
loop.check: the officer checks identity, effective date and every conflict before a record changes
loop.stop: stop on an identity mismatch, conflicting date or material credit change; open a manual review
loop.why_not_simpler: The target fields are known but customer documents and change notices vary.

steps.what: Apply approved field changes, attach the source document and retain the prior version
Investigate a material change that could affect the existing lending position

tasks.design: A {WORKFLOW} creates a file-update item from a change notice and compares the new document with current {CRM} fields. It writes only checked changes with their source and prior version; material changes remain with the loan officer.
tasks.previous_blocker: Updates are found in messages and documents, then copied into a credit file with limited visibility of the old value.
tasks.enabler_now: A record workflow can make field-level changes, source links and version history routine.
tasks.still_hard: A changed fact can signal a material credit issue rather than a clerical update.
tasks.human_edge: The officer distinguishes routine file maintenance from a change that warrants a lending review.

ambition.what: Run a weekly queue of material file changes that need a lending response.

tasks.altitude: The officer measures why files change and improves data collection at the source.

reach.task: Maintain a case file with source-linked updates
reach.learn: Separate a factual record correction from a material case change.

evidence.claim: A records app with an audit trail can replace spreadsheet and mailbox glue.

assumptions: The boundary starts when a credit-file change is received and ends when it is versioned or escalated as material.

The update contract contains case ID, customer ID, changed field, old value, new value, effective date, source document version, change reason and reviewer; the change notice and officer supply the fields.
Conflicting or unreadable evidence creates a manual review rather than an automated update.
Native CRM fields, audit history and notifications are tested before a custom update flow.
One hour per 100 focal-role baseline hours is allowed for source mapping and exception-rule maintenance.
unknowns: Which credit-file fields have an existing audit trail.
What events the lender defines as material changes.
research_questions: Which file updates are routine versus material?
How often are updates entered from an obsolete document version?

already_counted.description: Officer review of proposed updates and conflicts

incremental.description: Maintain change-source mappings and material-change rules

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes a substantial share of changes need a materiality check; one upkeep hour per 100 baseline hours is deducted.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Obtain and compile applicant credit histories and financial records.

steps.what: Request and record the applicant's consent for the required credit and financial sources
Retrieve available credit history and financial records from approved sources
Classify statements, accounts and financial periods into the application dossier

loop.input: bank statements, corporate financial statements and credit-history documents
loop.output: indexed dossier with entity, period, account and source links
loop.check: the officer checks entity identity, reporting period, totals and document completeness
loop.stop: stop on an unclear entity, missing period or unreadable document; request the source manually
loop.why_not_simpler: The required dossier fields are fixed but applicant and corporate documents use different layouts.

steps.what: Send a targeted request for records that cannot be retrieved or do not reconcile

tasks.design: A {WORKFLOW} records consent and retrieves available records into a source-linked dossier in the {CRM}. A bounded extraction indexes varied financial documents, while the officer checks identity and periods before using the dossier in credit assessment.
tasks.previous_blocker: The officer chases data across portals and attachments, then manually names and files documents for analysis.
tasks.enabler_now: Consented data retrieval and a document-indexing loop can prepare a traceable dossier.
tasks.still_hard: Consent, corporate ownership, document provenance and ambiguous periods require careful human review.
tasks.human_edge: The officer can decide which missing record is material and explain a targeted request to the applicant.

ambition.what: Give applicants a clear record-request list that distinguishes consented retrieval from documents they must provide.

tasks.altitude: The officer improves source coverage and evidence quality rather than downloading and renaming routine records.

reach.task: Use an indexed evidence dossier to test a financial assertion
reach.learn: Trace a ratio back to the source period and entity.

evidence.claim: Ockto passes consented public-source data to a lender through an integration.

assumptions: The boundary starts with a consent request and ends with a source-linked dossier or a targeted missing-record request.

The retrieval contract contains applicant ID, consent scope, source name, retrieval timestamp, document ID, entity, financial period, account, document version and provenance link; the applicant, approved source and officer provide the fields.
Unavailable sources and unreadable documents are requested manually and are never inferred.
Native consent capture and integration options are tested before custom retrieval code.
Two hours per 100 focal-role baseline hours are allowed for source-connection monitoring and extraction exceptions.
unknowns: Which sources can be accessed for each applicant type and jurisdiction.
Whether corporate statements arrive in a machine-readable form.
research_questions: What proportion of the dossier can be retrieved with consent?
Which document types fail identity or period checks most often?

already_counted.description: Officer review of consent scope and extracted dossier fields

incremental.description: Monitor source connections and document-extraction exceptions

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes unavailable sources and varied corporate documents still need manual requests; two upkeep hours per 100 baseline hours are deducted.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Run a daily exception review across incomplete applications, credit evidence and authority routes.
reach: personal financial advisor: recognise when an applicant needs broader budgeting or debt advice
role.ambitious_version: Give more applicants a complete, understandable path from enquiry to an accountable lending decision.
